\section{Overview}
Deterministic pipelines make debugging \textbf{straightforward}. When every stage has typed inputs and outputs, failures stay isolated.
\begin{itemize}
\item Keep data formats explicit.
\item Avoid hidden global state.
\end{itemize}
\begin{quote}
Reproducibility turns guesswork into engineering.
\end{quote}
